betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Tired of rockets landing in random fields? The §6Navigation Beacon§f emits a signal that guides rockets to a precise landing zone.

Crafted in vanilla: copper coils, Control Circuit Board, structure block, Tracking Circuit, and iron sheets. Burns 30 RF/t continuously. Any rocket with a Tracking Circuit installed will home in on the beacon and land within 10 blocks of it.

The GUI shows active rockets in range and their distance. Place a Docking Pad within 10 blocks of the beacon for best results, the rocket prefers the pad over bare ground.

§ePS:§f Put the beacon on a tall pillar, at least 10 blocks high, to maximize signal range. The taller it is, the further rockets can find it.
